title: Enough for dinner
text: We have a few friends for dinner tonight. There are a few vegetables in the fridge, but very little rice. Most people in our building eat at home on Sunday, so the shop is crowded. I have a little time before six, so I can go now. Do you have any questions about the menu? There are many options, but I have little information about the new dishes. Almost all of us like fish, and both of us can cook it.
